title: Dispensing-Error Refund Amount: Tailwise Pharmacy Billing Reconciliation Basis
content:
*Pharmacy billing, reconciliation of refunds.*

## The claimed fill

The Tailwise Pharmacy dispensing-error refund is figured on the claimed fill: the most recent dispensed fill of the prescription, on which the claim is recorded. The claim's error type is the error recorded on that fill: wrong medication, wrong strength, wrong quantity or wrong label. Every figure below is read from that fill as billed.

## The amount

The refund for a dispensing error is the claimed fill's merchandise subtotal less its discount, plus the shipping fee charged on that fill, plus the service fee charged on that fill, and the total is rounded half up to the cent.

In the terms of the refund entry:

| Part of the refund | Figure taken from the claimed fill |
|---|---|
| Merchandise portion | the merchandise subtotal less the discount |
| Shipping portion | the shipping fee charged on the fill |
| Service fee | the service fee charged on the fill (compounding and adult-signature fees) |
| Refund | the sum of the three, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked example (hypothetical fill)

A claimed fill was billed with a merchandise subtotal of $64.00, a discount of $0.00, a shipping fee of $4.95 and a service fee of $5.50.

- Merchandise portion: $64.00 less $0.00 is $64.00.
- Shipping portion: $4.95.
- Service fee: $5.50.
- Refund: $64.00 plus $4.95 plus $5.50 is $74.45.

A second hypothetical fill: merchandise subtotal $37.48, discount $7.50, shipping fee $0.00 and service fee $5.50. Merchandise portion $29.98; refund $35.48.

## Points of reconciliation

- Every figure is the one billed on the claimed fill.
- The merchandise portion is the merchandise subtotal net of the discount taken on the fill.
